text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to head higher at the opening bell on Tuesday with high tech and energy stocks stabilizing after yesterday's drubbing.

A sell-off in shares of 3Com Corp triggered by a profit warning for its present quarter led the downward spiral for technology stocks on Monday, but the sector stabilized in overnight trading in London.
"The techs got hit so badly yesterday that they will show some recovery today as will the energy stocks," said Hildegard Zagorski, analyst at Prudential Securities.
